description: Typed accessors from `glossa generate` (createMessages): a call <receiver>.<path>(…) whose path is a key's accessor path reports that key. Paths follow codegen: segments camelCased, colliding keys (payment-failed vs payment_failed) go to the first in sort order, a key that is also a group (nav.home vs nav.home.title) gets none. A one-segment path counts only on a receiver named `messages`. Files starting with a `// Code generated … DO NOT EDIT.` line are not scanned. Also passes runtime.t(id, values) with a dynamic id, which is not reported.
